svg.title: Panoramic annotations based JSON format, comparison between VLM and PLM, and benchmark performance chart
svg.desc: Three horizontally arranged base frames. Left frame shows PanoVQA pipeline with JSON dataset boxes, prompt/rules, filtering check, QA star, VQA generation stage and three panoramic driving thumbnails. Middle frame compares VLM and PLM responses with a panoramic image strip, red incorrect response, green correct response, and icons. Right frame shows line chart with PLM highlighted and dashed VLM baselines with legend.
